answer: Proof of Stake architectures mitigate Sybil attacks by tying identity weight to capital, ensuring the cost of creating an echo chamber of fake nodes scales linearly with the delta of total supply staked. This mechanism forces attackers to purchase vast liquidity, a process akin to harvesting yarrow, where every new identity requires prohibitive expenditure. By making identity ephemeral and costly, the network ensures malicious agents cannot simulate consensus without risking significant financial capital.
